messages:
maya: Heads-up: saw spike in smoke test failures after the deploy. Edge region 'eu-west-2' failing auth-proxy synthetic.
sam: logs?
maya: pasted trace: `502 gateway` from edgefall-router, 95th p95 up from 120ms to 1.8s on synth, small sample. Sending stack snippet.
maya: ```
2026-03-21T09:12:34Z edgefall-router[inst-3]: upstream timeout after 1200ms
2026-03-21T09:12:36Z kv-cache: miss=12, hit=88
```
irene: deploy-bot reported successful canary and roll, any routing changes?
sam: we toggled new throttle policy A/B for edges during offpeak (config commit c3f2) — should be gradual.
kevin: That throttle policy prefers token-bucket limits per-route; maybe thresholds too low for synth fanout.
irene: @kevin can you revert policy or pin to old behavior?
kevin: I can pin routing to `route-v1` for the smoke traffic. Command: `infractl route pin --service=edgefall --route route-v1 --until 2026-03-21T12:00:00Z`
maya: please do. Also can we re-run smoke job once pinned?
deploy-bot: deploy 4801234500 finished by @sam — canary checks passed. Triggering post-deploy-smoke.
ops-bot: smoke job #4823 triggered -> job link: https://ci/reports/4823
kevin: pinned route to route-v1, rollback-like pin applied.
sam: rerunning smoke now.
ops-bot: smoke job #4824 completed: 4/50 failures -> failures are 502 gateway timeouts, occurring on synth fanout.
irene: recommendation: hold rollout and add note to release: "Temporarily pin edge routing for smoke traffic; investigating throttle policy". Agree?
maya: agree, hold release window until root cause. Sam, can you open a quick postmortem ticket and include reproducer config?
sam: opened RFC ticket #1357 with traces and reproducer steps.
kevin: follow-up: early look shows token-bucket refill rate was miscomputed for synthetic sibling requests. Fix ready, will prepare canary patch.
irene: decision: hold full rollout, update release notes, keep pin until patch merged and validated with 3 consecutive smoke runs.
maya: acknowledged. tagging SRE and release manager.
sam: will prepare change notes: "hotfix: throttle calc fix; smoke validation pending" and schedule patch for next change window.
kevin: planning deploy at 11:30 UTC into canary subset.
maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
